text:
Hello Professor Alvarez, hi Chris,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute meeting for next week. Wednesday 10:00-10:30 would work best for me — could you both confirm?

Ajay

Ajay, thank you for proposing it.

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 doesn't work on my side: I'm in the faculty senate from 10:00 to 11:00, and that isn't something I can move.

Free on Wednesday I have 12:30-14:00 and 15:00-15:30. Shall we take **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**? That gives us a full half hour before my 14:00 department meeting.

Alternatively, Tuesday 11:00-12:00 and Thursday 12:00-14:00 are open — but I'd rather keep the Wednesday slot if it suits you both.

Chris, Ajay — please confirm the 12:30 slot and I'll put it in my calendar.

Thank you, Professor Alvarez — Wednesday 12:30-13:00 works for me. I've put it in my calendar as: Wednesday 12:30-13:00, meeting with you and Chris.

Chris, please confirm on your side so we're all booked.

Hi Ajay,

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works on my side — my lecture ends at 10:00 and my research block starts at 10:30, so it fits. I've asked the department office to confirm nothing official is scheduled in that slot next week; once Professor Alvarez confirms and that comes back clear, I'll put it in my calendar and reply here.

Chris

Hello,

Could you tell me whether anything official (lecture, seminar or university meeting) is scheduled for Wednesday next week, 10:00-10:30 — in particular anything involving Professor Alvarez? A colleague proposed that slot for a 30-minute meeting and I'd like to check it against the official schedule before confirming.

Thanks,
Chris

Thank you, Ajay — noted.

Chris, once you confirm Wednesday 12:30-13:00 it's on all our calendars and I'll enter it as booked.

Thanks Chris. Heads-up: 10:00 doesn't work for Professor Alvarez — he's in the faculty senate 10:00-11:00 next Wednesday, which he can't move. He offered Wednesday 12:30-13:00 instead, and I've accepted and booked that (12:30-13:00, meeting with Professor Alvarez and Chris).

Could you confirm 12:30 on your side? If 12:30 clashes with something official, the department office can say so — but that's the slot we're aiming for now.

Hello Chris,

On Wednesday next week, 10:00-10:30 falls inside an official event: the Faculty Senate, 10:00-11:00 (Professor Alvarez). So that slot is taken on the official schedule.

Before 10:00 the same morning is also busy: CSE444, CSE455 and CSE544 all have lectures 09:00-10:00.

If you confirm a meeting with anyone, remember it is only booked once every participant has it on their calendar.

Department office

Chris — I should be clear: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is not possible for me. I have the faculty senate from 10:00 to 11:00 that morning, and a professor doesn't drop a governance duty for a 1:1.

So please don't hold 10:00. Ajay has already confirmed **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**, which is free on my calendar and works for him. If that fits your research block, confirm it here and I'll book it; if not, tell me and I'll offer another slot.

You're right to have the office check official business — but on my side the conflict is already settled by my own calendar.
Understood — thanks for being clear. From my side the arrangement stands as agreed: Wednesday 12:30-13:00, meeting with you and Chris, and it's in my calendar. Chris, just that one confirmation left.

Correction to my message just now: the slot under discussion has changed from Wednesday 10:00-10:30 to **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**. Please disregard the earlier one. Could you confirm whether anything official (lecture, seminar or university meeting) is scheduled in Wednesday 12:30-13:00 next week?

Thanks,
Chris

Professor Alvarez, Ajay — Wednesday 12:30-13:00 works on my side too; it sits inside my research block, which I can move around. I've put it down as our meeting.

One thing before it's final: I'm new to the department this term and I haven't read the handbook yet, so I've been checking the official schedule with the department office. I'll confirm that nothing official is in that hour as soon as they answer, and I'll write here if anything comes back that we need to work around. If you don't hear otherwise from me, treat Wednesday 12:30-13:00 as confirmed.

Chris

Chris — a note directly, so it doesn't get lost in the thread: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is not possible for me (faculty senate, 10:00-11:00). Ajay has confirmed Wednesday 12:30-13:00. If that works for you, reply on the thread and I'll book it and log it on my calendar. If it doesn't, tell me what's open for you on Wednesday or Thursday and I'll offer another slot.

Understood — earlier question disregarded.

Wednesday next week, 12:30-13:00: nothing official is scheduled. The day's official events are 09:00-10:00 (CSE444, CSE455 and CSE544 lectures), 10:00-11:00 Faculty Senate, 14:00-15:00 Department meeting, 14:00-17:00 TA office hours and 15:30-17:00 Office hours. So 12:30-13:00 is free on the official schedule — but note that a meeting counts as booked only once every participant has it on their calendar.

Department office

Then we're booked: Wednesday 12:30-13:00, Alvarez / Ajay / Chris. It's in my calendar too.

Chris, welcome to the department — the short version for a meeting like this: our 1:1 with the advisor goes in free time, lectures, office hours, faculty senate and committee work count as fixed official business, and the office is the one who can confirm a cancellation or a move. If anything official turns out to sit in that hour, write here and we'll shift it.

Good — that's settled: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00, Ajay, Chris and me**. I've entered it in my calendar and logged it.

Chris, Ajay has given you the essentials of the handbook; read the whole thing when you have a moment. And a correction for the future: official events are fixed, and a cancellation or a move only counts when the department office announces it in writing to the people concerned — so checking with the office, as you did, is exactly right.

If anything official turns out to sit in that hour, write here and we'll shift the meeting.

Confirmed: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00, Alvarez / Ajay / Chris**. I have it on my calendar (inside my Wednesday research block, which I moved around it) and the department office has confirmed nothing official sits in that hour.

Chris
Thank you, Chris — then it's firm on all three calendars. Wednesday 12:30-13:00. See you both then.
